pymvpa.build: python setup.py build --no-libsvm followed by PYTHONPATH=build/py3k
compatibility_notes: The Python-2-era source is translated by the upstream setup.py build.
NumPy 1.23.5 retains the np.float alias used by this revision.
The runner removes the obsolete extradoc keyword before PyMVPA imports its scipy rdist compatibility class.
The source is a MATLAB toolbox. Octave lacks MATLAB import, so the wrapper supplies a no-op import function and adds +rsa/+util for unqualified package imports.
The executable Octave court is limited to distanceLDC, rankTransform_equalsStayEqual, and fitModelOLS; MATLAB-only workflow and GUI code is not claimed.
